name: Hayate Cycles
description: Hayate Cycles - a block theme for a bicycle shop and workshop. A two-line "Ride true. Ride on." heading opens the home page beside three off-grid low-key photographs that bleed off both edges of the screen; a hairline service index runs from new bikes to e-bike care, with capsule photographs on a dashed road line, a parallax ride band, a euro price table and an ink contact band. Schibsted Grotesk for headings, Inter for reading. Sample content in English: home page, inner pages, four stories and three house-line bikes. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
